subject: Renewal uplift and surge protection options
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@brightlayer.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal uplift and surge protection options

Hi Jordan,

Quick note from BrightLayer — we saw an unexpected product analytics spike in October that pushed usage to ~3.2x our baseline. Renewal is coming up in Jan and procurement asked whether we can do a mid-contract top-up or a short-term uplift instead of immediately renewing at higher commit levels.

Questions:
- Can you propose mid-contract top-up options (one-off vs staged)?
- Any guardrails you offer so we don’t pay for transient spikes (credits, grace windows)?
- Would joining a co-term early be possible and if so what discount bands would apply?

We need a simple option set to present to leadership by EOD Monday. Attached is our internal usage export for Oct.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
VP, Platform
BrightLayer

Attachment: brightlayer-usage-nov.pdf (PDF, 92 KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@brightlayer.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal uplift and surge protection options

Hi Alicia — thanks for the heads-up and for the export. High level we can offer two pragmatic paths so you have a clear choice quickly:

Option A — Phased top-up (recommended for transient spikes)
- Add a temporary "surge bucket" for the next 3 months sized to 150% of baseline usage.
- If the surge persists beyond 3 months, it auto-converts to a permanent uplift at a pre-agreed band.
- We provide a 30% credits buffer that refunds bursts above the bucket for the first billing cycle.

Option B — Accelerated co-term (recommended if this is sustained growth)
- Move renewal to co-term now, convert current run-rate into a 12-month commit with stepped volume discounts.
- Volume-triggered discounts: small (0-2x): standard; medium (2-3x): mid-band discount; large (>3x): deeper discount.

I attached a short worksheet with estimated numbers for both options (baseline assumptions filled from your file). If you want, we can:
- Lock in a 60-day grace period while you validate traffic trends, and
- Add a stepwise credit that triggers if usage drops back below the bucket within the first 90 days.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Pick A or B (or hybrid) so we can draft an amendment.
2) Quick call tomorrow (I’m free 10–12 PT) to walk numbers.
3) If accepted, we’ll generate a one-page amendment + DocuSign.

Attachments: JL-BrightLayer-Uplift-Options.xlsx (Excel, 48 KB)
DocuSign (draft link included below)

—
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Schedule: https://calendly.com/jordan-blake/30min

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: BrightLayer uplift — quick margin note

Jordan — quick internal note (reply-all intentionally internal):

We can support a staged/top-up approach but margin team wants to see the blended ASP if we move to the >3x band. At a high level:
- Approve up to 12% discount on uplift band for sales commitment; beyond that needs finance sign-off.
- Recommend we offer a 60-day grace/validation window (no backward billing) to limit churn complaints.
- For temporary surge buckets, we should cap the refundable credits to one billing cycle to avoid open-ended exposure.

I ran a quick calc and attached the file. If you propose an amendment, include the clause: "surge credits expire if usage normalizes for two consecutive months."

Attachment: margin-impact-quickcalc.csv (CSV, 6 KB)

Ben
Director, Revenue Operations

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@brightlayer.io>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal uplift and surge protection options

Alicia — following Jordan’s note and Ben’s margin guidance, here’s what we can put in the amendment if you decide to co-term now: 

Proposed amendment (summary)
- Term: Co-term to 2027-01-31 with a 12-month commit starting on that date.
- Staged Uplift Bands (applies to incremental usage above baseline):
  * 0–2x baseline: standard rate (no change)
  * >2x–3x baseline: 8% uplift discount
  * >3x baseline: 12% uplift discount (max authorized without CFO sign-off)
- Surge safeguard: 60-day validation period. If usage returns below the surge bucket for two consecutive months within first 90 days, customer receives a one-time credit equal to unused surge bucket (capped).
- Billing: top-up invoiced in next billing cycle; co-term amendment executed via DocuSign.

If that structure looks reasonable I’ll attach a draft amendment and pricing table for legal & procurement. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/20458 (we’ll update there).

Action: can you confirm acceptance of the banding above so we can push the amendment to DocuSign? If you prefer a larger credit buffer, flag it and I’ll loop in finance for approval.

Attachment: BrightLayer-Amendment-draft.pdf (PDF, 22 KB)
DocuSign (proposal link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/12345-uptick)

Thanks — Lauren Bishop
